name: Sinlabajos (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sinlabajos, surrounded by the motto SEÑORES, EL PUEBLO DE SINLABAJOS SALUDA A LOS FORASTEROS in a yellow ring.
history: Municipal flag of Sinlabajos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sinlabajos arms with the greeting motto in a ring
circular inscription SEÑORES, EL PUEBLO DE SINLABAJOS SALUDA A LOS FORASTEROS
